quote: Subsequent to the original Part 573 submission, three (3) vehicles outside the initially identified population presented related conditions.
reason: Undated sentence inside the 6/17/2026 entry (no blank line before it); it reports new field reports of the problem reaching the filer, so it is a later FILER_AWARENESS, not OTHER.

quote: Harbinger elected out of an abundance of caution to expand the population of potentially affected vehicles and to revise the remedy.
reason: Deciding to expand the recall population is a decision to recall (more vehicles), which is DECISION under the rules.

quote: 7/28/2026:  Customer 1 brought a truck to the dealer for an unrelated repair; during inspection the dealer found a missing ERCB bolt.
reason: The dealer finding is a field report reaching the filer (FILER_AWARENESS). X's 'The truck was repaired.' is repair of an affected vehicle, which counts as remedy logistics and is not an event.

quote: 7/30/2026:  Customer 2 complained of steering play, and dealer inspection of the vehicle found 3 missing ERCB bolts.
reason: A customer complaint and a dealer finding are reports of the problem reaching the filer, so the type is FILER_AWARENESS.

quote: 8/24/2026:  Customer 3 complained of alignment issues, and dealer inspection found 2 missing ERCB bolts.
reason: A customer complaint and a dealer finding are reports of the problem reaching the filer, so the type is FILER_AWARENESS.

quote: 7/28/2026 - 9/10/2026:  Harbinger Engineering evaluated whether the cause of the missing ERCB bolts was the same underlying condition as seen in the initial recalled vehicles
reason: Engineering conducted an evaluation to find the cause, so the type is INVESTIGATION_START.

quote: To better repair the condition, Harbinger developed and validated a new remedy that increases the friction between the ERCB and the mounting member and changes the torque procedure to torque to angle for higher accuracy.
reason: An undated action sentence inside the 7/28/2026 - 9/10/2026 entry, so it inherits that date. Developing and validating a remedy is an action, not mailing or repair logistics, so it is an OTHER event.

quote: On June 24, 2026, DTNA determined that a defect related to motor vehicle safety may exist.
reason: The rules say an acronym of the block company counts and give 'DTNA' for Daimler Trucks North America as the example. The narrative names DTNA, so S2 is SUPPORTED.

quote: Following feedback from a dealer about a potential issue with the entrance door, on May 27, 2026, DTNA initiated a review of the issue.
reason: The action dated May 27 is DTNA initiating a review of the issue, so the type is INVESTIGATION_START. The dealer feedback is only background in a subordinate clause.

quote: On July 30, 2026, DTNA updated its Defect Information Report to include a description of the recall remedy.
reason: Updating the Defect Information Report amends the Part 573 report, so the type is NHTSA_FILING.

quote: On August 25, 2026, DTNA further amended the Defect Information report by updating the description of the recall remedy
reason: Amending the Part 573 Defect Information Report is NHTSA_FILING.

quote: on June 19, 2026, Altec determined that a field action was needed to communicate the risk
reason: Determining that a field action (recall) is needed is the decision to recall, so the type is DECISION.

quote: From November 2025, through June 2026, FCA US TSRC reviewed warranty data, field records, and customer assistance records to understand potential customer consequence and vehicle scope.
reason: Reviewing warranty and field data to find the scope is analysis conducted (INVESTIGATION_START). Y quotes a different sentence (the meetings), so Y does not correctly label this event.

quote: On June 10, 2026, FCA US TSRC organization recognized that a vehicle build issue existed on certain vehicles
reason: The filer recognizing that a build issue existed is the filer becoming aware of the problem (FILER_AWARENESS). The decision on noncompliance comes later, on June 25.

quote: Loss of Pedestrian Alert function can occur due a software issue within the DSP module or an additional non-DSP related causal factor that is still under investigation.
reason: The sentence states a mechanism (a software issue in the DSP), which fits SUPPORTED. It also says another causal factor is 'still under investigation', which fits INSUFFICIENT. The rules do not settle which one wins.

quote: In March and April 2026, CCRG analyzed warranty claims and began its technical investigation.
reason: Beginning a technical investigation is INVESTIGATION_START, not OTHER. Y also keeps the date as written.

quote: By late June and July 2026, Ford’s Audio and IVI teams determined that the additional PAS system concern is related to a transient interaction between the ACM and the Accessory Protocol Interface Module (APIM)
reason: A dated sentence reporting an action (a determination of findings), so the event exists. A finding or test result is OTHER, and July 2026 is one of its distinct dates.
